items.mainDefect: With both authorization features enabled, client removal calls the throwing V2 setPermissionsEnabled implementation and aborts deletion.

secondary.defect: In V2-only mode, client removal skips cleanup and leaves orphaned per-client authorization resources and permissions.

items.mainDefect: Per-client authorization resources lack the Clients type, so getClientsWithPermission omits per-client grants.

secondary.defect: getClientsWithPermission returns the type-level resource name "Clients" as a client ID, causing incorrect results or null dereferences.
Missing cleanup on client removal leaves stale authorization resources whose deleted-client IDs can cause null dereferences.

items.mainDefect: The requireViewClientScopes javadoc incorrectly describes a boolean return instead of throwing ForbiddenException when access is denied.

secondary.defect: The adjacent requireView javadoc also incorrectly describes a boolean return instead of its exception contract.

items.mainDefect: testManageOnlyOneClient reads index 1 after asserting only that the list is nonempty, so a one-element list causes IndexOutOfBoundsException.

secondary.defect: testConfigureOnlyOneClient reads index 0 without checking for an empty list, potentially producing IndexOutOfBoundsException instead of the expected ForbiddenException.

items.mainDefect: The client-removal listener invokes the throwing V2 setPermissionsEnabled implementation, causing client deletion to fail.

secondary.defect: Client removal fails to clean up per-client authorization resources, leaving orphaned resources.
